headlines.title: Start Your Journey to Longevity With These Wellness Routines
headlines.description: From strength training for healthy aging to improving mobility and nutrition that promotes longevity, TODAY fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour, board-certified orthopedic physical therapist Karena Wu, and Start TODAY nutrition editor Natalie Rizzo share activities, meals, and motivation for your daily wellness routines.

headlines.title: Pancreatic Cancer Drug Shows Promise in Lung Cancer Trial
headlines.description: A groundbreaking drug for pancreatic cancer is now showing promise against the most common form of lung cancer. In a small trial, the drug shrank tumors in 31 to 37 percent of patients, depending on the dose. The next step is a larger trial.

headlines.title: Doctors fill CDC guidance void with new vaccine recommendations
headlines.description: Some of the nation's leading doctors are urging Americans to get their recommended flu, Covid, and RSV vaccines ahead of the upcoming respiratory virus season, stepping in with guidance amid uncertainty from the CDC. NBC News' Dr. Kavita Patel discusses the recommendations.

headlines.title: Is the Secret to a Healthy Relationship a Good Fight?
headlines.description: Conflict can actually deepen relationships, so Priya Parker, author of “The Art of Fighting,” stops by TODAY to talk about how to improve connections through productive fighting. She discusses misconceptions about conflict, how to “argue nicely,” and more.

headlines.title: How to clean your reusable water bottle and keep it mold-free and smelling fresh
headlines.description: To learn the best way to clean reusable water bottles from Stanley, Owala and other brands, I spoke to multiple microbiology experts for their guidance.

headlines.title: You might have recalled baby wipes in your home right now — here’s all the info you likely missed
headlines.description: Target has recalled Up&Up Baby Wipes for having life-threatening bacterial contaminants — I spoke to a pediatric infectious disease specialist to find out how this could effect you and your family.

headlines.title: Papier’s Advent calendar just launched with a new addition — they’re both going to sell out fast
headlines.description: The stationery brand Papier launched two new Advent calendars for the 2026 holiday season, both of which are likely to sell out well before December.

headlines.title: It’s now illegal to touch your phone while driving in some states — here’s how to stay compliant
headlines.description: More than 30 states now have hands-free phone laws banning handheld cell phone use while driving. See if your state made the list, what the penalties are and the best products to help you stay compliant.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: When is it safe to return home after a wildfire? California becomes first state to pass standards
headlines.description: California is poised to become the first U.S. state to set standards for testing and remediation for smoke contamination from wildfires, with a pair of bills passed Monday.

headlines.title: Her son fed goats at a petting zoo. He might’ve been exposed to rabies.
headlines.description: Three baby goats at a North Carolina petting zoo tested positive for rabies, sparking a statewide effort to track down everyone who interacted with the animals.

headlines.title: Four baby goats at mobile petting zoo in North Carolina test positive for rabies
headlines.description: Four baby goats from a North Carolina mobile petting zoo tested positive for rabies and were euthanized, and health officials are asking anyone who may have had contact with them to reach out for possible treatment.
